name: pdsl
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics, and formatting for the eBPF policy DSL (.pol)

pdsl.pythonPath.description: Optional override: Python interpreter that can import the `pdsl` package. Empty = auto-detect the repo's .venv (or fall back to `uv run`).

pdsl.cwd.description: Optional override: the policy_emitter directory. Empty = auto-detect from the extension location or open workspace folders.

pdsl.formatWidth.description: Column at which 'Format Document' wraps long expressions. Breaks at the loosest connective first (-> , then ||, then &&).
